firmware_evidence.scope: Evidence specific to the installed firmware and failed operation. Never infer a universal 15-second timeout from sense 04/08/01 alone.

implemented: Check file fails for unknown input instead of treating informational inspection as successful validation.
Malformed Pioneer flash inputs retain a localized FirmwareInvalid cause through wrapper errors.
Parser diagnostics distinguish non-file archive members from oversized components without relaxing archive admission.
Pioneer file inspection uses the same existing unrecoverable-tail check as Flash, including partial Kernel backups without granting flashability.
Separate libfreemkv branch records adapter bus metadata and Windows IOCTL response fields, including failing commands. Returned transfer length is explicitly not proof of wire acceptance.
next_evidence_required: Capture the failing command on the affected Windows drive connection, including bus/adapter identity, CDB, data-out bytes, completion/residue and sense.
Determine whether the two data bytes reach the drive and whether the data phase completes. Host API logs alone cannot prove this.

Only if host transfer framing is implicated, compare buffered and direct Windows SCSI requests in a controlled test with unchanged CDB, length and value; do not add automatic write retries or fallback to production.
Obtain the modified TAR to identify its actual invalid member. Existing parser diagnostics did not retain enough detail to reconstruct it.

candidate_transport_policy.candidate: Buffered SCSI pass-through for small transfers if affected-host evidence proves the direct path is failing.
candidate_transport_policy.qualification: Microsoft describes typical small/large transfer usage, not a ban on small direct transfers. Documentation alone does not establish the cause of this user's failure.

acceptance: Malformed and unrecognized inputs cannot produce a successful Check file result; GUI and CLI retain the same localized typed cause.
Existing valid and inspection-only files keep their documented behavior; no family, receiver, settings or archive safety gate is bypassed.
Any startup-write fix requires reproduction of the original failure followed by successful target-setting readback, completed firmware transfer and firmware readback on the affected connection.
A failed setting write remains a pre-update failure with separately recorded setting uncertainty; no claim of update entry or successful restoration without evidence.
Publish through the normal library/application QA release process after validation; do not retag or alter 0.15.1.
